description: The editor window asks for focus as soon as its page is running, and that is the whole of what it needs from the ACL. Snapdeck is a menu bar agent that is never the active application, so a window built at the front of its own stack still opens behind whatever the user was looking at; the request has to come from the page, because AppKit ignores one made before the window has been composited, which is exactly what the window builder's own focused flag was measured to do here. Nothing else is granted. The capture's absolute path arrives as a query parameter, reading the PNG uses the asset protocol scope declared in tauri.conf.json, and saving, copying and closing all go through this application's own commands, which are not gated by the ACL. In particular the clipboard is not granted: the edited picture is encoded in the page and copied by Rust, which has to decode it for the pasteboard anyway, so a second path from the webview to the clipboard would be a permission with no caller.
